postTitle: Is 0% EMI or Buy Now Pay Later Really Free? When Free Is Free
topic: Is 0% really free? Only if the price matches paying now; a lost discount is the cost

assumptions.notes: Blog example (Jiri): a €1,200 laptop as twelve month-end payments of €100 at 0%, or €1,140 paid now. Difference €60. Twelve month-end €100 payments against €1,140 now: an annual rate of about 10% (lesson's script). Studies (NBER, Central Bank of Ireland 2025) find paying later tends to raise spending. The 10% a year equivalent stays in the lesson and caption teaser, not the reel (council Nov 5: number budget and retell).
